q: 1. Endurance limit of mild steel is approximately equal to
explain: The endurance (fatigue) limit of mild steel is approximately 0.5 times its ultimate tensile strength.

q: 2. The rock which is not calcareous is
explain: Laterite is an iron/aluminium-rich residual soil/rock formed by weathering, not a calcium-carbonate (calcareous) rock like limestone or chalk.

q: 3. The rocks which are formed due to cooling of magma at a considerable depth from earth's surface are called
explain: Plutonic (intrusive) rocks form from magma that cools slowly at considerable depth below the earth's surface, producing coarse-grained crystalline rock.

q: 4. Depending on the chemical composition and mechanical properties, iron may be classified as
explain: Based on carbon content and resulting mechanical properties, iron/iron alloys are broadly classified into cast iron, wrought iron, and steel — covering all the listed types.
